water.goalBody: It is a suggestion. Adjust it to what makes sense for you.
water.goalInvalid: Use an amount between {{min}} and {{max}} ml.
water.everyBody: Water reminders stop for the day once you reach the goal.

breaks.paceBody: The recommended pace comes from the study with 5-minute walks every 30.
breaks.typesBody: Suggestions take turns among the kinds that are on.
breaks.typesMin: Keep at least one kind on.

focus.blockBody: It is the block that starts when you start focusing.
focus.goalBody: How much focus time makes sense in a day, for you.

workday.title: Working hours
workday.hoursBody: Reminders only appear within these hours.
workday.daysBody: On the other days the app stays quiet.

install.title: Install
install.pitch: Installed, HealthyWork opens in its own window and reminds you even when minimized.
install.safariMac: In Safari, open the File menu and choose Add to Dock.
install.ios: On iPhone or iPad, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen.
install.other: In Chrome or Edge, use the install button in the address bar.
install.installed: HealthyWork is already installed on this device.

data.title: Your data
data.importBody: The data on this device will be replaced by the file. This cannot be undone.
data.importSummary: The file has {{water}} water records, {{breaks}} breaks and {{focus}} focus blocks.
data.importNotHealthywork: That file is not a HealthyWork backup. Nothing was changed.
data.importNewer: That file comes from a newer version of HealthyWork. Update the app and try again.
data.importInvalid: That file is incomplete or damaged. Nothing was changed.
data.importUnreadable: That file could not be read. Nothing was changed.
data.eraseBody: All your records and settings will be erased from this device. This cannot be undone. If you want to keep a copy, export first.
data.privacy: Everything is saved on this device only. Nothing is sent to any server.
